info.title: Tahsil API
info.description: The Tahsil API manages the catalog, customers, checkout sessions, subscriptions, invoices, payments and refunds of a Tahsil installation. Calls take an API key as a bearer token, carrying the permission each operation names; `ths_test_` keys reach a Test mode installation and `ths_live_` keys a Live one. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable, machine-readable `code` and a `traceId`.

patch.description:
`items` replaces the item set. Changed `now` (the default), it is prorated by `prorationBehavior`: `always_invoice` bills the difference at once and charges it like a first invoice (a credit goes to the customer's balance), `create_prorations` leaves it for the next renewal, `none` bills nothing until then. With `effective: period_end` (and optionally a later renewal as `effectiveAt`) it is stored as `scheduledChange` and applied at that renewal. Prices with another interval restart the period now. A higher price for an individual customer must be scheduled at least `Tahsil:Subscriptions:PriceIncreaseNotice` ahead.

Requires the `tahsil.subscriptions:write` permission.

post.description:
`at: period_end` (the default) or a time within the current period schedules the end, which `resume` takes back; `at: now` ends it at once, bills its pending items on a final invoice unless `invoiceNow` is false, and may refund the unused share of the period (`prorated`) or the last payment in full (`last_payment`). A refund that fails does not undo the cancellation; it becomes an attention item or a `refund.failed` event.

Requires the `tahsil.subscriptions:write` permission.

id.description: The API key, administrator subject or customer ID; `null` for the system.

ActorResponse.description: Who did something: an API key, an administrator, a customer on a hosted page, or Tahsil itself.

advanceBy.description: An ISO 8601 duration such as `P1M`, `P14D` or `PT2H`.

AdvanceClockRequest.description: Moves the billing clock forward in Test mode: by an ISO 8601 duration such as `P1M`, or to an instant (ENG-22).

ApiKeyResponse.description: An API key, without its secret. `DisplayPrefix` is the start of the secret, to recognize the key by.

AuditEventResponse.description:
An action recorded in the audit trail. `action` reads `resource.past_tense_verb`, such as
`api_key.revoked`. People are referenced by ID only, so the trail outlives their personal data.

at.description: `period_end` (the default), `now`, or an RFC 3339 timestamp within the current period.

refund.description: Only with `at: now`; anything but `none` also needs `tahsil.refunds:write`.

invoiceNow.description: With `at: now`: bills the subscription's pending items on a final invoice (the default), or deletes them.

CheckoutCustomerDetails.description: A customer to create when they submit the checkout form; one with the same external ID is reused.

price.description: A price ID or lookup key.

quantity.description: 1 when omitted; none for metered prices.

oneOf.description: For subscriptions: what each renewal bills.

CheckoutQuoteResponse.description: The first invoice as computed for the customer, which is what they pay; never taken from the browser.

CheckoutRecurringResponse.description: What each renewal bills: a period of the recurring items, every `intervalCount``interval`s.

url.description: The page to send the customer to; returned when the session is created only, since Tahsil keeps just its hash.

couponId.description: The coupon the quote is discounted by: the API's, or that of the code the customer entered.

trialDays.description: Days of trial, counted from completion; `0` turns off the prices' default trial.

trialEnd.description: The end of the trial; takes precedence over `trialDays`.

daysUntilDue.description:
For a connection that cannot save cards, whose subscriptions are invoiced: days from an invoice's finalization
to its due date, 0 by default.

CheckoutSubscriptionData.description: The subscription a subscription session creates.

CheckoutSubscriptionResponse.description:
The subscription the session creates: its trial, whether the trial collects a card, and how its invoices are
collected (`send_invoice` when the connection cannot save cards).

permissions.description: The permissions the key may use; its creator must hold them.

expiresAt.description: When the key stops working; it does not expire when omitted.

amount.description: Minor units: positive gives the customer credit, negative adds to what they owe.

description.description: Why the balance changes, such as `Goodwill credit`.

customer.description: An existing customer's ID; otherwise `customerDetails` describe one to create.

items.description: What is sold, in one currency; none in setup mode. Metered prices take no quantity.

oneOf.description: For subscription sessions: the subscription to create.

currency.description: Required in setup mode; otherwise the items' currency.

allowPromotionCodes.description: Shows a field on the page where the customer may enter a promotion code.

coupon.description: A coupon's ID or key to discount the session by; or give string? CreateCheckoutSessionRequest.PromotionCode. Counted when the session completes.

promotionCode.description: A promotion code to apply for the customer, ignoring case.

locale.description: `tr` or `en`; the customer's language when omitted.

successUrl.description: Where the customer goes after paying; `{CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}` is replaced with the session's ID.

clientReferenceId.description: The application's own reference, such as an order number.

expiresIn.description: An ISO 8601 duration from `PT30M` to `PT24H` (the default).

credentials.description: The provider's credential fields. Stored encrypted and never returned.

settings.description: The provider's setting fields, as strings, numbers or booleans.

name.description: Shown to customers, such as `Launch discount`.

percentOff.description: Above 0 and at most 100, with up to two decimals; or give long? CreateCouponRequest.AmountOff.

amountOff.description: In minor units of string? CreateCouponRequest.Currency; or give decimal? CreateCouponRequest.PercentOff.

durationInCycles.description: For `repeating`: the number of cycle invoices, 1 to 120.

products.description: IDs or keys of the products it applies to; every product when left out.

externalId.description: The application's own ID for the customer, unique; most applications address customers by it.

name.description: A person's full name or a company's legal name.

phone.description: Stored in E.164 when it reads as a phone number.

taxId.description: For Turkey: a TCKN for individuals, a VKN (or the owner's TCKN) for companies. Stored encrypted.

locale.description: `tr` or `en`; the installation's default when omitted.

CreatedApiKeyResponse.description: A new API key with its secret `Key`, which is shown only this once. Callers send it as `Authorization: Bearer ths_…`.

CreatedWebhookEndpointResponse.description: A new endpoint and its signing secret, which is shown only now.

subscription.description:
A subscription of the customer whose next invoice takes the item; while its cycle invoice is still a draft, the
item joins that draft. The currency must be the subscription's.

price.description: A one-time price in the currency, by ID or lookup key; or give a description and a unit amount.

unitAmount.description: Minor units, negative for a credit; for items without a price.

taxRate.description: For items without a price: a tax rate by ID or key.

daysUntilDue.description: For `send_invoice`: days from finalization to the due date; `Tahsil:Invoices:DefaultDaysUntilDue` when omitted.

includePendingItems.description: Adds the customer's pending items in the invoice's currency that belong to no subscription.

coupon.description: A coupon's ID or key for this invoice alone; redeemed when the invoice is finalized.

uniqueProperty.description: For `unique_count`: the event property whose distinct values are counted.

returnUrl.description: Where the portal's "Return" link leads, such as the application's billing page.

locale.description: `tr` or `en`; the customer's language when omitted.

CreatePortalSessionRequest.description: A portal session for a customer the application has authenticated.

key.description: A unique lookup key, such as `pro-monthly-try`.

transferKey.description: Moves string? CreatePriceRequest.Key from the price that holds it to this one.

unitAmount.description: In minor units, such as 29900 for ₺299.00.

unitAmountDecimal.description: Fractional minor units, for metered prices below one minor unit.

meter.description: The meter's ID or key, for metered prices.

taxRate.description: The tax rate's ID or key; untaxed when omitted.

kimlikPlan.description: The key of the Kimlik plan a subscription to this product grants.

code.description: 3 to 40 letters, digits, `_` or `-`; stored in uppercase and matched ignoring case.

firstTimeOnly.description: Only customers without a paid invoice may redeem it.

minimumAmount.description: The smallest invoice subtotal, in minor units of string? CreatePromotionCodeRequest.MinimumAmountCurrency.

customer.description: The only customer who may redeem it.

amount.description: Minor units; what is left to refund of the payment when omitted.

card.description: A simulator test card number, such as `4242424242424242`.

expYear.description: Four years from now when omitted.

CreateSimulatorPaymentMethodRequest.description: Test mode only: a saved simulator card for a customer, without a browser (SIM-7).

items.description: Recurring prices in one currency with the same interval, at most 20.

defaultPaymentMethod.description:
The card to charge; the customer's default when omitted. Needed for `charge_automatically` without a
trial: the first invoice is charged during the request.

trialDays.description: Days of trial; `0` turns off the prices' default trial.

trialEnd.description: The end of the trial; takes precedence over `trialDays`.

daysUntilDue.description: For `send_invoice`: days from an invoice's finalization to its due date, 0 to 365.

billingCycleAnchor.description:
A later start of the billing cycle without a trial, at most one interval away, such as the first of the next
month; the time until it is billed as a shorter first period.

coupon.description: A coupon's ID or key to discount the subscription by; or give string? CreateSubscriptionRequest.PromotionCode.

promotionCode.description: A promotion code the customer gave, ignoring case.

percentage.description: Between 0 and 100, with up to four decimals, such as 20.

inclusive.description: Whether prices using the rate include the tax.

key.description: What provisioning documents know the endpoint by; optional.

url.description: An HTTPS URL; plain HTTP only for this machine in Test mode.

eventTypes.description: The event types it receives; none means all.

secret.description: The signing secret (`whsec_` and base64); one is generated when omitted.

set.description: Whether the connection has a value.

last4.description: The last four characters of values long enough to keep them secret.

CredentialState.description: Whether a credential is set; credentials are never returned (SEC-9).

CustomerAddress.description: A billing address; `country` is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, such as `TR`.

CustomerExportResponse.description: Everything Tahsil holds about a customer, for data subject requests (KVKK).

CustomerSnapshotResponse.description: The customer's billing details when the invoice was finalized.

DiscountResponse.description:
A coupon applied to a subscription: through which code, since when, and for `repeating` coupons how many
renewal invoices it still applies to.

InvoiceDiscountResponse.description: A discount on an invoice, with what it took off in total.

price.description: A one-time price in the invoice's currency, by ID or lookup key.

unitAmount.description: Minor units, for lines without a price.

taxRate.description: For lines without a price: a tax rate by ID or key.

InvoiceLineRequest.description: A line to add: a one-time price, or a description with a unit amount (negative for a credit).

appliedBalance.description: The customer balance it would apply: positive when credit is spent, negative when a debt joins or the invoice becomes credit.

InvoicePreviewResponse.description: An invoice as it would be created, without being created (SUB-24).

hostedInvoiceUrl.description: The page where the customer sees and pays the invoice (INV-24); none for drafts.

discounts.description: The discount and what it took off, by name, as the invoice shows it.

appliedBalance.description: The customer balance applied at finalization: positive when credit was spent, negative when a debt joined.

dunningStartedAt.description: When dunning started: the first failure of an automatic payment for the customer, or the due date passing.

dunningDeadlineAt.description: When dunning's final action runs if the invoice stays unpaid.

KimlikSubscriber.description: The Kimlik user or organization a customer is.

amount.description: Minor units; what is left to pay when omitted. A smaller amount is a partial payment.

receivedAt.description: When the money arrived; now when omitted.

reference.description: How the payment is identified, such as a transfer's reference; at most 100 characters.

OutOfBandPaymentRequest.description: Money received outside Tahsil, recorded against an invoice (INV-14).

paymentMethod.description: A saved card of the customer to charge now.

oneOf.description: Money received outside Tahsil, such as a bank transfer.

PayInvoiceRequest.description: Pays an invoice now: with one of the customer's saved cards, off session, or by recording money received outside Tahsil.

PaymentMethodResponse.description: A saved card, with what may be shown about it; never card data.

reference.description: What the provider knows the payment by.

failureMessage.description: A message safe to show the customer.

PortalSessionResponse.description: A portal session. `url` is given once, when the session is created: Tahsil keeps only its hash.

PriceTier.description: A tier of a tiered price: units up to `upTo`, unbounded for the last tier.

ProviderCapabilitiesResponse.description: What a provider can do; values are snake_case names.

required.description: Whether a connection must have it.

description.description: Where to find the value, or what it changes.

default.description: The value when none is given.

ProviderFieldResponse.description: A credential or setting a provider's connections take.

ProviderResponse.description: A payment provider Tahsil has an adapter for.

currencies.description: The currencies routed to this connection; currencies not listed keep their routing.

credentials.description: The provider's credential fields; omitted ones keep their values.

settings.description: The provider's setting fields, as strings, numbers or booleans; omitted ones keep their values.

ProvisionedConnection.description:
A payment provider connection and the currencies it serves. In a startup file, credentials are configuration
references such as `${Iyzico:ApiKey}`, so secrets never live in version control.

percentOff.description: Fixed once created; or give long? ProvisionedCoupon.AmountOff.

amountOff.description: Fixed once created, in minor units of string? ProvisionedCoupon.Currency.

products.description: Keys of the products it applies to; every product when left out. Fixed once created.

ProvisionedCoupon.description: A coupon and its promotion codes. The discount, duration and products are fixed once created.

meter.description: The meter's key, for metered prices.

ProvisionedPrice.description:
A price of the product. Only the name, trial, archive flag and metadata may change; a new amount is a new price with a
new key.

ProvisionedPromotionCode.description: A promotion code, matched by its code ignoring case. Only bool ProvisionedPromotionCode.Active can change once created.

eventTypes.description: The event types it receives; none means all.

secret.description: The signing secret; a new one replaces the current secret, which keeps signing for the rotation overlap.

ProvisionedWebhookEndpoint.description: A webhook endpoint. In a startup file, its secret is a configuration reference such as `${Tahsil:AppWebhookSecret}`.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema editors use for completion and validation.

ProvisioningDocument.description:
What an installation sells and how it is wired, declared so it can live in version control and be applied the same
way to every environment. Items are matched by key; applying creates what is missing and updates what differs, and
never deletes: retire an item with `isArchived`, or `enabled: false` for connections and endpoints.

ProvisioningResult.description: What applying a document did, or would do in a dry run.

price.description: A recurring price, by ID or lookup key.

quantity.description: For licensed prices, 1 when omitted; metered prices take none.

oneOf.description: The invoice the change creates now; none for scheduled changes, `create_prorations` or `none`.

pendingLines.description: The proration lines that would wait for the next renewal, with `create_prorations`.

oneOf.description: The next renewal after the change: when, and its total.
The discount its invoices get while it lasts.

incompleteExpiresAt.description: When an incomplete subscription expires unless its first invoice is paid.

TimeTravelResponse.description: What a time travel did, step by step (ENG-23).

checkoutsPaused.description: Pauses or resumes new checkouts on the connection, such as during card testing (CHK-22); saved cards keep being charged.

UpdateConnectionRequest.description:
Changes a connection. Credentials and settings merge: the fields given replace the current values, the others stay;
an empty credential or a `null` setting removes an optional field. The key, provider and environment never change.

maxRedemptions.description: Not below the redemptions so far; `null` removes the limit.

isArchived.description: Archived coupons and their codes redeem no more; existing discounts continue.

UpdateCouponRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch: omitted fields stay, `null` clears. The discount, duration and products never change.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch: omitted fields stay as they are, `null` clears.

coupon.description: A coupon's ID or key for the draft; `null` removes it.

UpdateInvoiceRequest.description:
JSON Merge Patch. Drafts: the collection method, days until due, memo, coupon and metadata. Finalized invoices:
only the legal invoice and metadata.

transferKey.description: Moves string? UpdatePriceRequest.Key from the price that holds it to this one.

UpdatePriceRequest.description:
JSON Merge Patch of what may change: the lookup key, name, trial, archive flag and metadata. Anything else is
refused with `price.immutable`: a new amount is a new price.

isArchived.description: Archived products sell no more; existing subscriptions keep renewing.

UpdateProductRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch: omitted fields stay as they are, `null` clears.

UpdatePromotionCodeRequest.description: Only the active flag changes: deactivate a code to stop it, reactivate it to allow it again.

UpdateSimulatorPaymentMethodRequest.description:
Test mode only: how a saved simulator card answers from now on (SIM-8): `succeed`, a failure code such as
`insufficient_funds`, `timeout_after_charge`, `timeout_before_charge` or `pending`.

prorationBehavior.description: For changes now outside a trial; `always_invoice` by default.

effectiveAt.description: With `effective: period_end`: a later renewal of the subscription to change at, such as one far enough for a price increase notice.

skipNotice.description: Applies a price increase without notice; for company customers only.

trialEnd.description: While trialing: a new end of the trial, or `now` to end it at once.

defaultPaymentMethod.description: The card to charge; `null` falls back to the customer's default.

oneOf.description: For active subscriptions; applies from the next invoice.

daysUntilDue.description: With `collectionMethod: send_invoice`: days from finalization to the due date, 0 to 365.

oneOf.description: Only `null`, which drops the scheduled change.

coupon.description: A coupon's ID or key that replaces the discount; `null` removes it.

promotionCode.description: A promotion code that replaces the discount.

UpdateTaxRateRequest.description: The percentage and inclusion never change; create a new rate instead.

UpdateWebhookEndpointRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch: omitted fields stay, `null` clears the description, and an empty list of event types means all.

WebhookSecretResponse.description: The new signing secret, shown only now; the previous one keeps signing until `previousSecretExpiresAt` (EVT-8).

ApiKey.description: An API key created in the admin panel or through the API, such as `ths_test_…`.
